settings.title: The Science of Radiance
settings.subtitle: Experience the synergy of clinical-grade LED light therapy combined with our proprietary serums for unmatched results.

settings.title: Targeted LED Therapy
settings.text: Our tri-wave technology utilizes deep penetrating light at optimal bandwidths to target cells beneath the skin's surface. Blue light eliminates acne-causing bacteria, while red and near-infrared light stimulate collagen production and reduce inflammation.

settings.title: Micro-Pulse Technology
settings.text: Gentle micro-vibrations enhance blood circulation and maximize serum absorption, leading to deeply nourished skin that glows from the inside out.
